description: Graduates a hired recruiting candidate into a staff member (candidate_id, from read the candidate), as Promote to staff does: it creates the ONE person record (retagging their contact to staff) or, when an active same-named staffer already exists, returns name_conflict so you can confirm the link. A name_conflict is not an error: read the returned existingStaffId and call again with link_to_staff_id to link them. Idempotent on the candidate's staff lineage. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: promote_candidate
title: Promote a hired candidate to staff
